How we calculate uptime

Availability = (observed minutes − unavailable minutes) ÷ observed minutes. Each daily sample observes 1,440 minutes. Incident duration can include investigation and recovery, so it differs from unavailability. Planned maintenance with no availability loss counts as 100%. Daily bars are green at 100%, amber at 99%–under 100%, red below 99%, or gray for planned maintenance. Mobile bars aggregate each week using the same minute totals; the final bucket may be shorter. The aggregate weights all ten services equally. All records are illustrative, not CloudSync telemetry.

Select any bar for its date, exact availability and incident note. Bars also support keyboard focus and Enter.
